prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE cozy island game production facility: A squat pufferfish-inspired brass compression machine, round copper pressure chamber with short blunt rivet studs, two short pipe handles, fierce eyebrow-shaped gauge housing, sturdy teal feet and tiny steam nozzle. Distinct mechanical machine not a living fish..
MANDATORY CAMERA AND DIRECTION: the attached approved tin stove is a COMPOSITION + CAMERA + STYLE reference for this entire facility set. Match its exact isometric viewpoint, elevation and facing, never mirror it. The FRONT/main opening of the new facility faces toward the LOWER-LEFT of the image, like the stove door in the reference. Its RIGHT side recedes toward the UPPER-RIGHT; top surfaces are visible from the same slightly elevated camera. If there is a doorway, kiln door, main dial or press opening place it on that left-front face. Right-side hardware may project to the right. Do not turn the front toward lower-right; do not use a head-on camera. Keep vertical walls vertical. Light consistently from upper left.
STYLE: warm hand-painted dimensional shading, clean dark brown edge accents, rounded craftsmanship, tactile wood/copper/enamel/stone, restrained seafoam/copper/cream colors adapted to this design. Match polish but NOT the reference tin-can silhouette.
COMPOSITION: one complete distinct machine/building and compact integrated base, centered horizontally on a SQUARE 1:1 transparent canvas. Base bottom at 88% image height. Overall artwork contained between 10% and 90% of canvas on all sides, including highest chimney. No detached smoke, scene, sky, people, UI, labels, letters, numbers, grid, border or large external cast shadow. Genuine alpha transparency. Make it beautiful and tidy, readable as a small game facility.
referenceRole: camera, facing, composition and style; identity remains the unique facility concept
